text: I'm sorry to bother you, I'm probably being silly. I'm looking after my grandson, he's 6. He's got a sore throat and he's been a bit sorry for himself, but he is drinking, I've made sure. I read all these things online and got myself in a state, so I checked his neck. He can put his chin down and look at his toes no bother, I think that's what you're meant to check? I saw purple marks all over his legs and my heart went. Then I realised it was felt tip, he'd been drawing on himself with his cousin. It scrubbed off in the bath, there's nothing underneath and no rash anywhere, I did the glass test anyway just in case. I'm not sure if I should just let him sleep or if there's something else I ought to be looking for. I worry, you see
